units.title: Introduction to Cryptography & Classical Ciphers
topics: Security Goals: Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability, Non-Repudiation, Authentication
OSI Security Architecture: Attacks (Passive vs Active), Services, and Mechanisms
Classical Substitution Techniques: Caesar Cipher, Monoalphabetic, Playfair, Hill Cipher, Polyalphabetic (Vigenère)
Transposition Techniques: Rail Fence, Columnar Transposition
Steganography vs Cryptography and Cryptanalysis Techniques

units.title: Modular Arithmetic, Number Theory & Symmetric Ciphers
topics: Modular Arithmetic: Divisibility, Euclidean and Extended Euclidean Algorithms
Prime Numbers: Fermat's and Euler's Theorems, Euler's Totient Function phi(n)
Chinese Remainder Theorem and Discrete Logarithms
Feistel Cipher Structure, Simplified DES (S-DES), and Data Encryption Standard (DES)
Advanced Encryption Standard (AES): S-Box, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey
Block Cipher Modes of Operation: ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, CTR

units.title: Asymmetric Cryptography, Hash Functions & Digital Signatures
topics: Public-Key Cryptography Principles and Trapdoor One-Way Functions
RSA Cryptosystem: Key Generation, Encryption, Decryption, and Security Vulnerabilities
Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Algorithm and Man-in-the-Middle Attack
Cryptographic Hash Functions: SHA-512, MD5, and Message Authentication Codes (HMAC)
Digital Signature Standard (DSS / DSA) and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)

textbooks: William Stallings, 'Cryptography and Network Security: Principles and Practice', 7th Edition, Pearson
Behrouz A. Forouzan, 'Cryptography and Network Security', McGraw Hill
references: Bruce Schneier, 'Applied Cryptography: Protocols, Algorithms, and Source Code in C', Wiley
Alfred J. Menezes, Paul C. van Oorschot, Scott A. Vanstone, 'Handbook of Applied Cryptography', CRC Press

units.title: Digital Image Fundamentals & Acquisition
topics: Elements of Visual Perception: Eye Structure, Photopic vs Scotopic Vision, Brightness Adaptation

Histogram Processing: Histogram Equalization, Histogram Specification (Matching), Local Enhancement
Spatial Filtering Fundamentals: Correlation vs Convolution, Smoothing Linear Filters (Box, Gaussian), Order-Statistic Filters (Median, Max, Min)
Sharpening Spatial Filters: First and Second Derivatives (Laplacian, Gradient, Sobel, Prewitt), Unsharp Masking, and Highboost Filtering

units.title: Morphological Operations & Segmentation
topics: Preliminaries: Sets in Mathematical Morphology, Reflection, Translation, Structuring Elements
Dilation and Erosion: Algebraic Properties, Dualities
Opening and Closing: Properties and Noise Filtering
Hit-or-Miss Transform, Boundary Extraction, Hole Filling, and Connected Components Extraction
Morphological Reconstruction, Thinning, Thickening, and Skeletons
Image Segmentation: Point, Line, and Edge Detection, Thresholding (Otsu's Method), Region Growing

units.title: Supervised Learning, Regression & Classification
topics: Machine Learning Paradigms: Supervised, Unsupervised, Semi-supervised, Reinforcement Learning
Linear Regression: Hypothesis Representation, Mean Squared Error Cost Function, Batch & Stochastic Gradient Descent
Multiple Linear Regression, Normal Equation, and Feature Scaling / Mean Normalization
Overfitting and Underfitting: Bias-Variance Tradeoff, L1 Lasso and L2 Ridge Regularization
Logistic Regression: Sigmoid Function, Cross-Entropy Loss, Decision Boundaries, Multi-class Classification (One-vs-All)
Generative vs Discriminative Models, Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), and Naive Bayes Classifier

units.title: Neural Networks, Deep Learning & Support Vector Machines
topics: Biological Neuron vs Artificial Perceptron, Perceptron Learning Algorithm, XOR Problem
Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) Architecture: Hidden Layers, Universal Approximation Property
Activation Functions: Sigmoid, Tanh, Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU), Leaky ReLU, Softmax
Backpropagation Algorithm: Forward Propagation, Computational Graphs, Multivariate Chain Rule Derivations
Optimization Algorithms: Momentum, RMSProp, Adam, Mini-Batch SGD, Learning Rate Schedules
Support Vector Machines (SVM): Maximum Margin Hyperplane, Hard-Margin vs Soft-Margin (C parameter), Kernel Trick (Polynomial, RBF)

textbooks: Christopher M. Bishop, 'Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning', Springer
references: Kevin P. Murphy, 'Machine Learning: A Probabilistic Perspective', MIT Press
Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, Aaron Courville, 'Deep Learning', MIT Press
